why: Private park known only from the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025, re-fetched 2026-11-21: '349 SHEYENNE RV PARK, 500 COTTON AVE, Sheyenne ND 58374, Eddy, licensee JOHNSON, RALPH ROGER, licensed 12/26/2024, 13' lots) with no live web presence or price indicator, checked 2026-11-21: web searches for the name (alone, with Sheyenne/58374, with Cotton Ave, with Facebook) return only Sheyenne Oaks (Leonard, Cass County, ~180 km SE) and Hendrickson Park; Google Maps (gm.py) for the name, the address and 'RV park Sheyenne ND' resolves to Sheyenne Oaks Campground in Leonard or to the bare town, no place at the address; RV Life (Algolia, 30 km radius + 'sheyenne' name query) has only Hendrickson Park, Warsing Dam, Schuster (New Rockford), Spirit Lake Casino and Graham's Island; not in the Good Sam directory cache (nothing within 15 km). Fails both the presence and the price indicator.
name: Sheyenne RV Park
flags: Not a duplicate: no DB entry within 24 km (nearest 5881 Graham's Island State Park, 24.3 km); no DB name contains 'Sheyenne' in ND. 6009 Hendrickson Park (the entry whose drop surfaced this lead) is already gone.

Location is the Census geocode of 500 Cottonwood Ave, Sheyenne (the HHS 'Cotton Ave'; approximate). Esri World_Imagery 2026-11-21 (~670 m frame, rendered): at the NE edge of the town grid, just east of the point, a block holds ~10 long white units parked side by side in rows on grass, which reads as a small RV/trailer lot; no office, pedestals or published layout to say whether it sells nights or is monthly/seasonal.
Licensed only since 12/26/2024, so it may be new and could publish a presence later; would re-open if the operator publishes a website, booking page or a Google listing with a nightly rate.

Possible other lead, NOT vetted and not in the DB: RV Life lists 'Warsing Dam Campground' (park_type county, Sheyenne, 47.83142,-99.10602, 5 stars, $), and The Dyrt has 'Eddy County Warsing Dam' (described there as primitive, in a fish and wildlife area). It may be a public campground worth a lead; I did not research it.
